project_type: Next.js 16 career management app with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: npm with Next.js build. Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss (no tailwind.config.ts). PostCSS config in postcss.config.mjs.
test_framework: vitest with node environment, tests in src/lib/__tests__/
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx eslint src/ and confirm 0 errors. 2. Run npx vitest run and confirm no new failures beyond the pre-existing llm-parse-job mock issue. 3. Run npx next build and confirm it exits 0.
environment_constraints: node_modules already installed. No database available for runtime testing. Build-time type checking via next build is the primary verification. Network allows npm install (COMMON_DEPENDENCIES mode inferred from successful npm install).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Push to feature branch and create PR.
key_patterns: All pages use a Nav component header. Pages are server components or 'use client' with fetch calls. Components use Tailwind utility classes inline. Current styling uses bg-white, bg-gray-50, border-gray-200, rounded-lg, shadow-sm cards pattern throughout. The style guide requires removing all of this: no fills (except one live element), no rounded corners, no shadows, ruled rows instead of cards.
directory_structure: src/app/ contains route pages (page.tsx). src/components/ has shared components. src/components/tracker/ has tracker-specific components. src/components/profile/ has profile-specific components. src/app/company/[slug]/ has company detail tab components. src/lib/ has utility/business logic. prisma/ has schema. Reference implementation at /projects/partyswoop/ shows completed style guide with Tailwind v3 config.
